channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Shaedon Sharpe | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Shaedon Sharpe from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons, Scoot Henderson, Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Joe Cronin:

“What I will say about Shaedon Sharpe, Scoot Henderson and Anfernee Simons is that they're going to be 'win-now' players very, very soon.”

Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons, Scoot Henderson, Shaedon Sharpe, Jul 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Chauncey Billups, Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Law Murray:Tyronn Lue on Shaedon Sharpe:

“He's gotten way better defensively. And then offensively, the game is slowing down for him...just talking to Chauncey about him last couple of days, he's really excited about this young kid and how he's been playing, how he's matured and grown.”

Tyronn Lue on Chauncey Billups, Shaedon Sharpe, Apr 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Chauncey Billups on Shaedon Sharpe's first national TV game, where he is expected to start:

“If I tell him about those things, it just adds pressure to the situation. Every game he plays is on TV. The channel doesn't matter.”

Chauncey Billups on Shaedon Sharpe, Nov 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Damian Lillard on Shaedon Sharpe:

“The talent is off the charts. Everything is effortless. But I really like his disposition, how calm he is. The types of questions he asks, he listens, he shows up every day. I think when it connects, he can make a huge difference.”

Damian Lillard on Shaedon Sharpe, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Chauncey Billups on Shaedon Sharpe:

“I didn't see him play as much, other than our scouts showing me some of his high-school clips. Just an incredible talent. Uber talent. Can do it all. We watched him work out in Chicago and we all left there kind of amazed.”

Chauncey Billups on Shaedon Sharpe, Jun 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Joe Cronin on Shaedon Sharpe:

“He was our guy all along. We weren't confident he'd be there at 7.There were a few teams ahead of us that thought could take him. You're waiting and waiting, and then when you hear a certain name called and your guy gets to you, it creates energy.”

Joe Cronin on Shaedon Sharpe, Jun 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.
